name: RailSlicer
summary:
RailSlicer puts you on a speeding rail cart and throws the beat at you. Every target is placed from the song itself, so every cut lands with the music. Swing your left and right blades, slice in the direction you choose and feel each hit snap to the rhythm.

EARLY ACCESS CONTENT
- 3 worlds: a rain-soaked Neon City, the Egyptian Pyramids at sunset and the North Pole with ice tunnels, deep crevasses and falling snow
- 12 original electronic tracks
- Full-body pose walls: strike the glowing pose with your arms
